thread:
olivia: Morning team :wave: Quick async standup — GPU fleet notes for today.

olivia: What I did — kicked off AMS prewarm for the demo traffic, validated spot/reserved mix, filed INFRA-3421 for az allocation.

olivia: Blockers — one of the AMS nodes (gpu-ams-12) failed an init script, still seeing 1/12 capacity pending; logs point to a driver timeout.

sam: Saw that, added a disk-attach retry in the startup script. Will redeploy the node in ~10m. :wrench:

liam: For context, the scheduled demo will need ~350 concurrent sessions at p50 200ms token latency. We should maintain 15% spare headroom across AMS and ORD.

priya: Today — I'll complete the quota request form for GCP AMS (need to increase GPUs by +8 spot, +2 reserved). Link to form: https://internal.redwood/gcp/quota-request. Pinged cloud-accounts for approval.

olivia: FYI opened a quick PR for terraform bump: PR #7856 — increases reserved pool in ams and adds fallback routing to ord. Please review when you can, especially the placement constraints.

sam: Reviewing PR #7856 now. Noted a minor naming nit for the instance template. Also can we lower the autoscale threshold from 0.85 to 0.8 during the demo window to avoid queueing?

liam: Agreed on autoscale tweak. Set in config: autoscaler.p50_target=0.8 for ams-demo policy. Remember to revert after 6 hours or add a calendar rule.

priya: Cloud-accounts asked for justification string; I used: "prewarm for customer demo, maintain latency SLOs under peak load". If anyone has metrics to attach, drop them here.

olivia: Attached quick qps/tokens chart (snippet):
```
window=10m avg_tokens/s=420 -> estimate GPUs_needed=18 (quantized)
```

infra-bot: deploy-status: gpu-ams-12 redeploy started by sam at 1758433600. Logs -> https://internal.redwood/logs/gpu-ams-12

sam: Redeploy succeeded :thumbsup: node rejoined the pool. Current ams available_gpus=20, reserved=6, spot=14.

liam: Small ask — can someone sanity-check routing policy? If ams falls below 10% spare headroom, route new sessions to ord until ams recovers. I can draft the policy if needed.

priya: I can follow up with cloud-accounts on quota ETA. If approval is slower than expected, propose we enable short-lived burst capacity in ord as fallback (no SLA impact for demo).

olivia: Blocker resolved by sam, thanks. Remaining: PR reviews and quota approval. Planning to join the demo runbook run at 09:45 UTC. If anyone has last-minute blockers, call it out here.

sam: Quick FYI — raised a CR to add a healthcheck that checks driver + nv_peer_mem before marking node ready. CR-1198.

liam: I'll review the healthcheck CR after breakfast. Also adding a temporary alert: alert_gpu_headroom_breach -> Pager if <10% and sustained 3m. :fire_engine:

priya: I'll watch the quota thread and post updates. If approved, I'll attach the support case ID here.

olivia: Thanks team — nice quick turnaround. If nothing else, keep this thread updated with any evictions or scaling blips. :eyes:

infra-bot: reminder: scheduled demo window is 1768560000 -> 1768567200 (UTC).
